behaviors: A valid batch imports packets from several logical notebooks and persists immutable source and packet identities
Every packet binds to its exact exported request, notebook manifest, ATHENA profile, jurisdiction, units, and notebook
One invalid packet leaves no authoritative final batch event or partial source index
The same source across notebooks deduplicates to one canonical record while conflicting identity reuse fails closed
Exact replay is idempotent and changed content or invalid successor lineage fails closed
Precise citations and unresolved conflicts, limitations, and gaps remain visible in the builder bundle
Task preparation resolves only the frozen task's declared integrated SourcePacket dependency nodes
ATHENA has research-improvement permissions but no code, database, rule, quantity, price, approval, or bid authority
A clean runtime distribution excludes Build Fabric, research tooling, providers, and generated research artifacts

capability: Build the usable multi-notebook ATHENA source-packet intake, canonical public-source registry, and task-scoped builder bundle boundary for Codex and Claude.

block.action: Block that behavior and preserve the file-based receiving boundary.
block.when: Acceptance requires NotebookLM, Grok Bot, a browser session, credentials, or a live network call.

escalation.action: Correct once or split the failing behavior; do not enter a repeated suite loop.
escalation.when: The focused gate fails after the substantive implementation attempt.

reroute.action: Create an explicit replacement task and assignment without relabeling provider work.
reroute.when: The identified external builder cannot complete the bounded task.

stop.when: The patch writes runtime/P0/P1A facts or grants ATHENA code, rule, quantity, price, approval, or bid authority.

deliverables: Strict eleven-notebook manifest and bounded ATHENA profile
ResearchRequest export and atomic multi-packet SourcePacket import
Finite repository-local research CLI and distribution boundary
frozen_interfaces: ResearchRequest exports through repository-local file transport without provider calls
SourcePacket batch import validates every packet before its final authoritative event
One source identity may retain memberships in multiple logical notebooks
BuilderSourceBundle resolves only a frozen task's integrated SourcePacket dependencies
Research tooling and artifacts remain absent from the runtime wheel
schema_impact: Adds six build-control JSON contracts and zero runtime or SQLite migrations
